messages:
paul: Heads-up: new customer-facing guide for Private KMS/HSM rotation and billing reconciliation is ready for review. Focus is on low-downtime rotations and how attestation artifacts map to invoices. Link: https://redwood.docs/internal/private-kms-rotation-guide :eyes:

mina: Quick skim: useful. One addition: note that HSM-backed sign/unwrap latency can add 50-120ms per session init; recommend session reuse and long-lived envelopes where possible.

security: Agreed. Also clarifying that attestation tokens must NOT contain PII and should be stored in the customer's audit repository. We added an example signed_manifest.json in the appendix.

paul: Finance flagged a common question: customers expect to see re-encryption/rotation operations in billing. We drafted an FAQ explaining that rotation metadata is logged to usage buckets but only billable operations (e.g., extra API calls to Redwood-hosted keywrap) appear on invoices.

finance: Confirmed. We'll provide a sample reconciliation CSV that maps rotation events to invoice lines. We'll also include a short note about "no-charge" policy for internal rotation dry-runs when run with --dry-run.

mina: Ops note: include recommended overlap windows in the playbook. Short example snippet for on-prem teams that hit older probes:

```
rotation:
  overlap_minutes: 30
  parallel_reencrypt_limit: 8
  probe_timeout_seconds: 6  # legacy agents
  verify_after_swap: true
```

security: Addendum: when using HSM-only KMS, customers should expect attestation verification to take longer during peak; recommend scheduling rotations in low-traffic windows and adding a 2x retry for sign operations.

paul: KB-bot published the draft to staging. deploy-bot: can you push docs to staging?

deploy-bot: Deploy started: docs/private/kms-rotation-guide -> staging (build 20260518.3)

paul: Action items: @mina update probe/timeouts and append HSM latency guidance, @security attach signed_manifest example and attestation schema version (v1.2), @finance add reconciliation CSV and dry-run billing note. We'll have a 20-min sync tomorrow 11am PT to sign off.

finance: I'll add the sample CSV and a short explainer on invoice mapping.

mina: I'll add a troubleshooting section: common failures are HSM timeouts, missing registry creds when re-pushing signed images during rotation, and locked vault keys.

paul: Great. Target: GA publish early next week if no blockers. Ping me for urgent issues. :lock:
